Messages.Author: Rehlow
Messages.Body:
LSJ,

I have Nehsi in my ash heap. Saqqaf plays Eternal Mask at superior,
targetting Nehsi, moves all his blood to Nehsi and plays Daring the
Dawn at inferior. The action is successful and I would gain 1 pool
from Saqqaf's special before Daring the Dawn burns Saqqaf with 2
aggravated damage (Saqqaf has no blood because he moved it all to
Nehsi), correct?

Next, Nehsi plays Eternal Mask at superior, targetting Saqqaf, moves
all his blood to Saqqaf and plays Daring the Dawn at inferior.

Finally, Saqqaf plays Eternal Mask at superior, targetting Nehsi,
moves all his blood to Nehsi and plays Daring the Dawn at inferior. I
now gain another 1 pool, because this Saqqaf and this special ability
is different than what happened earlier due to the ash heap wiping
memory, correct?

Thanks,
~Rehlow

Saqqaf's special
If Saqqaf successfully performs an action requiring Serpentis, you
gain 1 pool. You may only gain 1 pool this way each turn.

Eternal Mask
+1 stealth action.
[ser] (D) Bleed at +1 bleed.
[SER] Put this card on this vampire and move a unique vampire from
any
ash heap to your ready region with any amount of blood from this
acting vampire. The minion with this card cannot take actions, block,
play reaction cards or vote. You may burn this card and the chosen
vampire during any untap phase.

DtD as above.

> Finally, Saqqaf plays Eternal Mask at superior, targetting Nehsi,
> moves all his blood to Nehsi and plays Daring the Dawn at inferior. I
> now gain another 1 pool, because this Saqqaf and this special ability
> is different than what happened earlier due to the ash heap wiping
> memory, correct?

Correct.

Messages.Author: RocketEddy
Messages.Body:


So what happens if Saqquaf plays EM with daring the dawn, and targets
another Saqquaf in the ash heap. Do you end up with one ready untapped
Saqquaf with all the blood of the original, one burned Saqquaf, and
one more pool than you started?

Or does the Saqquaf entering play contest the original and burn
immediately (before you can move blood), and then the original takes 2
agg?

Messages.Author: witness1
Messages.Body:


You can't choose to self-contest, and thus can't target Saqqaf in the
ash heap if you've already got one in play.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
RocketEddy wrote:
> So what happens if [Saqqaf] plays [Eternal Mask] with daring the dawn, and targets

> another Saqquaf in the ash heap. Do you end up with one ready untapped
> Saqquaf with all the blood of the original, one burned Saqquaf, and
> one more pool than you started?
>
> Or does the Saqquaf entering play contest the original and burn
> immediately (before you can move blood), and then the original takes 2
> agg?

It comes into play "with any amount of blood from this vampire", so you can move
blood to it. But then the incoming copy would burn (not sticking around to see
if the acting vampire would eventually be burned by Daring the Dawn).

You would still gain a pool for the successful action, though.
